label: Brunost
comment: Whey boiled down until its sugar browns; ricotta is the other way, the whey's proteins set out of it by heat and acid.

about.text: Brunost is a common Norwegian name for mysost, a family of soft cheese-related foods made with whey, milk, and/or cream. The characteristic brown color and sweet taste result from milk sugars being caramelized after boiling. The term brunost is often used to refer to fløtemysost or Gudbrandsdalsost, which are the most popular varieties.
